subject: Synthesis & vote: Marquez (SWE Staff) — final tally and ownership
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Synthesis & vote: Marquez (SWE Staff) — final tally and ownership

Hey all,

Thanks again for taking (or joining) the loop with Marquez on Friday. I pulled together the raw notes and a blank scorecard to make the final tally straightforward — attached. Quick ask: please drop your numeric score (1-5) and a one-line justification in the sheet by EOD Wednesday so we can either move to committee or request a short follow-up.

Key context:
- Role: Staff SWE (backend systems)
- Interviewers: Jonas (arch), Marissa (algorithms), Tessa (product/behavioral), Neha (safety/standards)
- Interview length: 90m onsite loop

Concrete asks:
1) Fill scorecard-Marquez.xlsx with score + 1-line note
2) If you have an abstain or conditional hire, note the condition in the ‘notes’ column
3) Reply-all once done so I can mark the poll and close the loop

Attachments: marquez_resume.pdf, scorecard-Marquez.xlsx, interview-notes-raw.txt

Thanks — I’ll synthesize and propose a path forward on Thursday morning unless there’s a strong objection.

Vanessa Ortiz
Talent Partner, Hiring Operations

Subject: Re: Synthesis & vote: Marquez (SWE Staff) — final tally and ownership

Thanks Vanessa — I added my score (3/5) in the sheet.

Quick color: Marquez is excellent at product framing and stakeholder sense, but I saw signs of optimism bias on delivery timelines and limited examples of cross-org negotiation. If we push, I’d like a brief follow-up with a PM to validate the framing assumptions.

If others are split, I’d vote we ask for 30m with a PM rather than an outright no.

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Nov 2028 15:18:07 -0800
Subject: Re: Synthesis & vote: Marquez (SWE Staff) — final tally and ownership

Added my score (5/5) and notes — see sheet.

Longer note: technically top-tier for systems design and scaling. My only hesitation is about preference fit — candidate prefers IC growth over people management. I think this maps fine to the role we described. If we’re worried about organizational ramp, propose a 3-month success plan: pair with senior infra owner, deliver one measurable latency or throughput improvement, and then reassess scope expansion.

I’m +1 to move forward and will champion on the hiring committee if we get to that stage.

Jonas Weber
Senior Staff SWE, Platform

Subject: Re: Synthesis & vote: Marquez (SWE Staff) — final tally and ownership

Thanks all — tally attached and synthesized below. Final ask: if you have a hard no, reply now; otherwise I’ll treat non-response as tacit approval and submit to committee on Monday.

Tally (numeric average): 4.0/5
- Marissa: 4 (algorithms caveat)
- Tessa: 3 (product/delivery concerns)
- Jonas: 5 (technical champion)
- Neha: 4 (safety checklist request)

Proposed path forward:
- Move candidate to hiring committee (I’ll put this on the Monday agenda)
- If committee approves, offer to include a 3-month measurable success plan and a written data-handling confirmation
- If any of you prefer a short PM follow-up instead of committee, flag now and I’ll schedule 30m next week

Related links: https://greenhouse.example/candidate/Marquez-1234, https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1a2b3c-marquez-tally

Attachments: scorecard-Marquez.xlsx (finalized), marquez_resume.pdf

Thanks again — I’ll close the loop after committee.
